question: Vandana Luthra is an Indian inspirational entrepreneur, who is the founder of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**VLCC Healthcare.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vandana Luthra is an Indian inspirational entrepreneur, who is the founder of VLCC Healthcare.**
 
• **Vandana Luthra:**
 
 
• She has received the honor of **Padma Shri in 2013** for her contribution to trade and industry.
 
• **Her other achievements include:**
 
 
• The Asian Business Leaders Forum Trailblazer Award in 2012.
 
• The Enterprise Asia Women Entrepreneur of the Year Award in 2010.
 
• She was ranked 26th in the distinguished annual Forbes Asia 2016 list of 50 Power Businesswomen in the APAC region.
 
• She also got featured in Fortune magazine's annual listing of the ‘50 Most Powerful Women in Business in India’ for consecutive five years (2011 to 2015).
